item.title: Lawrence Beauty Brands to close later this month
item.description: Beauty Brands will permanently close later this month after nearly three decades in business in Lawrence. Continue reading ...

item.title: Douglas County seeks input via survey on trash, recycling and other waste management
item.description: Douglas County is requesting feedback on its management of trash, recycling, organics and other waste materials. Continue reading ...

item.title: Crafts, hobby horses and scavenger hunt at Watkins Museum to get kids in the holiday spirit
item.description: Although Lawrence’s Old-Fashioned Christmas Parade won’t take to the streets this year, the show will go on for the Watkins Museum’s accompanying Tails and Traditions Holiday Festival. Continue reading ...

item.title: ‘By hook or by crook,’ the Lawrence Public Library’s collections team gets books, materials in patrons’ hands
item.description: Even as the library world experiences turbulence with the closure of a major book distributor, the oft-unseen denizens of the Lawrence Public Library’s basement remain steady in delivering materials to their patrons. Continue reading ...

item.title: Kansas will get the world’s first mile-deep nuclear reactor and the groundbreaking is next week
item.description: Parsons, Kansas, will be the site of a startup’s first ever 1-mile-deep nuclear reactor, and the groundbreaking is next week. Continue reading ...

item.title: Kansas governor says ‘One Big Beautiful Bill Act’ could cost state $150 million or more
item.description: The "One Big Beautiful Bill Act" is expected to cost Kansas at least $150 million as provisions cutting health care programs go into effect, Gov. Laura Kelly said in an interview with Kansas Reflector. Continue reading ...

item.title: Construction on Bob Billings to reduce road to one lane for multiple blocks
item.description: Starting Monday, a construction project will reduce traffic on Bob Billings Parkway to one lane in each direction between Monterey Way and Kasold Drive. The city expects the work to take a year. Continue reading ...

item.title: Lawrence Holiday Homes Tour, benefiting Habitat for Humanity, to return
item.description: An annual holiday homes tour that helps fund a nonprofit's efforts to create affordable housing is coming up Sunday, Dec. 7. Continue reading ...

item.title: City study on North Lawrence corridor, Grant Township to progress with open house, survey
item.description: A city team is planning an open house to present the findings of last month's North Lawrence corridor visioning session. The project also encompasses tracts of land from unincorporated Grant Township. Continue reading ...

item.title: Participants in Lawrence debate on affordable housing all want to see people housed, but the ‘how’ is complicated
item.description: A city co-sponsored debate on affordable housing was not a forum for steel to meet steel, but for community members to question how the city, county and community could ensure more people can afford to be housed. Continue reading ...
